verses: In the magpie's nest Dwells the dove at rest. This young bride goes to her future home; To meet her a hundred chariots come.
Of the magpie's nest Is the dove possest. This bride goes to her new home to live; And escort a hundred chariots give.
The nest magpie wove Now filled by the dove. This bride now takes to her home her way; And this numerous cars her state display.
